Arrival at Jerusalem was 5 Ramadan 438, rendered 1047 by Le Strange p. 23; the text does not establish the date of composition. documented_description means a dated text or image, so dating that event to the visit risks presenting 1047 as the writing date. Use dated_assertion for the reported circumstances of the 1047 visit, explicitly distinguish composition date unknown, and retain year-bound visit basis. Do not assert direct hospital inspection.
Schefer pp. 66 and 70 and Le Strange pp. 23 and 26 support visit and content. The Met quotation of Thackston is a derivative account, not independent corroboration.
Earliest dated account can imply date of text; rephrase as earliest episode supported here, reported for the 1047 visit, with date of writing unknown.
The medieval travel account is a contemporary textual witness to the period described, not a surviving contemporary manuscript or independently dated composition.
Account names an endowment and stipends but does not identify its patron, assets, eligibility, fees, founding date or other expenses; uncertainty is appropriate.

Le Strange p. 26 places Friday mosque wall by Wadi Jahannam; the hospital is in the Holy City, not unequivocally placed at the spring. No asserted institutional continuity; source-specific textual variations remain research questions.
